description: Source code for managing and manipulating reftable blocks, including reading, writing, compression, decompression, and iteration over block records.

methods.name: header_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the block header based on version.

methods.name: footer_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the block footer based on version.

methods.name: block_writer_register_restart
methods.description: Registers a restart point in the block writer.

methods.name: block_writer_init
methods.description: Initializes a block writer with specified parameters.

methods.name: block_writer_type
methods.description: Returns the type of the block being written.

methods.name: block_writer_add
methods.description: Adds a record to the block.

methods.name: block_writer_finish
methods.description: Finalizes the block writing process, including compression if needed.

methods.name: read_block
methods.description: Reads a block of data from the source at a specified offset.

methods.name: reftable_block_init
methods.description: Initializes a reftable block from source data.

methods.name: reftable_block_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a reftable block.

methods.name: reftable_block_type
methods.description: Returns the type of a reftable block.

methods.name: reftable_block_first_key
methods.description: Retrieves the first key in a block.

methods.name: reftable_block_init_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator over a block.

methods.name: block_iter_init
methods.description: Initializes a block iterator.

methods.name: block_iter_seek_start
methods.description: Resets iterator to start.

methods.name: block_iter_next
methods.description: Advances iterator to next record.

methods.name: block_iter_reset
methods.description: Resets iterator state.

methods.name: block_iter_close
methods.description: Closes and releases iterator resources.

methods.name: block_iter_seek_key
methods.description: Seeks to a specific key in the block.

methods.name: block_iter_seek_void
methods.description: Seek implementation for void pointer.

methods.name: block_iter_next_void
methods.description: Next implementation for void pointer.

methods.name: block_iter_close_void
methods.description: Close implementation for void pointer.
